deletion_policy.description: This field uses a custom implementation please refer to documentation under /hashicorp/terraform-provider-google-beta/website/docs/r/chronicle_rule.html.markdown for specifics

etag.description:
The etag for this rule.
If this is provided on update, the request will succeed if and only if it
matches the server-computed value, and will fail with an ABORTED error
otherwise.
Populated in BASIC view and FULL view.

instance.description: The unique identifier for the Chronicle instance, which is the same as the customer ID.

location.description: The location of the resource. This is the geographical region where the Chronicle instance resides, such as "us" or "europe-west2".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

rule_id.description: Rule Id is the ID of the Rule.

scope.description:
Resource name of the DataAccessScope bound to this rule.
Populated in BASIC view and FULL view.
If reference lists are used in the rule, validations will be performed
against this scope to ensure that the reference lists are compatible with
both the user's and the rule's scopes.
The scope should be in the format:
"projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}/dataAccessScopes/{scope}".

text.description:
The YARA-L content of the rule.
Populated in FULL view.
